The 'Smoke' in its name indicates it carries tobacco and likely related products alongside typical convenience store staples. Its location in a ferry-adjacent community makes it a potentially useful stop for cyclists passing through or catching the Tsawwassen–Swartz Bay or Tsawwassen–Duke Point sailings.
